newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Mariwasa says plans debt papers issue.
newsitem.headline: Mariwasa says plans debt papers issue.

text.p: Philippine-based ceramic tile maker Mariwasa Manufacturing Inc said on Friday it plans to issue 200 million pesos worth of one-year commercial paper to augment its working capital.
In a filing with the Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission, Mariwasa said 50 percent of the papers would carry fixed-rate interest and the remaining would be on a floating-rate basis.
The firm has yet to peg the fixed-rate interest while the floating rate would be based on the average 91-day treasury bill rate two weeks prior to the issue, plus a premium of 1.25 percent.
All Asia Capital and Trust Corp has been hired as lead underwriter of the debt issue. ($1 = 26.3 pesos)
